notes: Aputure LS 600d Pro is a professional daylight-balanced LED film/video light (Bowens-mount head + separate control box), not a conventional AV signal-chain device — no category/type in the taxonomy fits well, so category="other"/type="Other" was used. Not rack-mountable (handheld control box on a light-stand quick-release clamp), so rackUnits omitted. Primary source: Aputure's official LS 600d Pro Product Manual (English), which includes labeled control-box front/back panel diagrams — accessed via its FCC filing mirror (fccid.io/2AABZ-LS600DPRO) since it is the same document Aputure publishes; cross-checked against Aputure's live product page (aputure.com/en-US/products/ls-600d-pro) and the LS 600d Pro Control Box page. The control box also has a mechanical V-Mount or Gold-Mount (Anton Bauer) battery plate that is itself a power input, but that connector type isn't in the provided connector taxonomy (it's a proprietary blade/clip battery mount, not XLR/barrel/etc.), so it was omitted as a discrete port rather than mis-mapped; batteries: 14.4V-28.8V, ≥180Wh. No HDMI/SDI/video ports exist on this device — it is a lighting fixture, and its only "signal" I/O is DMX and Ethernet for lighting control. IP54 weatherproof rating with rubber port covers on all connectors.

ports.name: PowerCON Power Input
ports.note: Neutrik powerCON female locking connector, AC 100-240V 50/60Hz, ≤720W draw, on the control box

ports.name: Battery Input (DC)
ports.note: 48V/15A DC input for external power stations, per control-box rear panel diagram in the official product manual; pin count (3-pin XLR) corroborated by Aputure's own product page and CineD's LS 600d launch article rather than shown explicitly in the manual diagram

ports.name: 5-Pin XLR Power Output
ports.note: Proprietary 5-pin XLR head-cable output on the control box that feeds power + control data to the lamp head via the supplied 5-pin male-to-female cable; not a DMX or audio signal

ports.name: DMX IN
ports.note: DMX512 5-pin XLR input for daisy-chaining/controlling the fixture from a DMX console

ports.name: DMX OUT
ports.note: DMX512 5-pin XLR output for daisy-chaining additional fixtures

ports.name: RJ45 Port
ports.note: Wired Ethernet for Art-Net/sACN control (one of 4 control systems: Bluetooth, 2.4G, LumenRadio, Ethernet); link speed not stated in manual so grade omitted

ports.name: USB Port
ports.note: Labeled 'USB Port' on the control box side panel in the manual diagram; exact USB type (A vs C) and function (firmware update, etc.) not spelled out in text, USB-A inferred from the diagram icon shape — treat as medium-confidence detail within an overall high-confidence source
